tasks.label: DiamondCar: Stripe Webhooks
args: $line = Get-Content -LiteralPath '${workspaceFolder}/Server/.env' | Where-Object { $_ -match '^STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $line) { throw 'STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is missing from Server/.env' }; $env:STRIPE_API_KEY = $line.Substring($line.IndexOf('=') + 1).Trim(); stripe listen --events 'payment_intent.succeeded,charge.refunded' --forward-to 'http://localhost:8000/stripe/webhook'

tasks.label: DiamondCar: Open Android Studio
args: $fromPath = Get-Command studio64.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $toolbox = Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA/JetBrains/Toolbox/apps/AndroidStudio" -Filter studio64.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $candidates = @($fromPath.Source, "$env:ProgramFiles/Android/Android Studio/bin/studio64.exe", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/Android Studio/bin/studio64.exe", $toolbox); $studio = $candidates | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $_) } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $studio) { throw 'Android Studio was not found. Add studio64.exe to PATH or update this task.' }; Start-Process -FilePath $studio -ArgumentList '${workspaceFolder}/Client/mobile-app'
